transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Doctor, I’ve been feeling absolutely incredible lately, just bursting with energy and barely needing any sleep at all for the past six months! My mood keeps jumping from pure, ecstatic happiness to being super annoyed at the slightest things, but I just feel so alive and unstoppable. I've got so much to do and I don't want to waste a single second sleeping!
During these times, have you ever seen or heard things that others couldn't, or had beliefs that other people found highly unusual or hard to believe?

Yes, when my energy is this high, I definitely experience some unusual things, like hearing voices that other people can't hear. I also get these strong beliefs that I have special, unique powers or that people are secretly watching me. But these things only ever happen during these times when I'm feeling so incredibly energized.
Have you ever heard those voices or had those beliefs during times when your mood was completely normal and your energy was at its usual level?

No, not at all. I only hear those voices and have those beliefs when my energy is extremely high and my mood is elevated. When I'm feeling normal and my energy is at its usual level, I don't experience any of those things.

latest_inference.note: The patient describes a prolonged period of elevated, irritable mood, decreased need for sleep, and high energy lasting six months, which is indicative of a manic episode. During these episodes, they experience auditory hallucinations and persecutory/grandiose delusions. Crucially, the patient states these psychotic symptoms occur exclusively during these high-energy manic phases and never during periods of normal mood, ruling out Schizoaffective Disorder and establishing a diagnosis of Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features.
